en.title: Letter Case Difference
en.description:
Count the number of uppercase English letters in typedText minus the number of lowercase English letters.

Rules follow the original OAMaster problem; the input/output protocol and bounds marked "site-added" were compiled by this site.
en.input: A non-empty string containing only English letters A-Z and a-z; length 1..200000 (site-added).
en.output: Output the uppercase count minus the lowercase count.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for details.
hints: Check against the problem definition item by item, paying attention to simultaneous updates and boundary semantics.
